payment_method_reuse_agreement.description: Settings related to the payment method reuse text shown in the Checkout UI.

promotions.description: If set to `auto`, enables the collection of customer consent for promotional communications.

terms_of_service.description: If set to `required`, it requires cutomers to accept the terms of service before being able to pay. If set to `none`, customers won't be shown a checkbox to accept the terms of service.
